summary: Read root spend in the web Details pane over the last 7 days instead of the last day.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of persisted state.

schema.detail: No database, wire or client-v0 schema changes. The relay already accepted window=7d.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Live pages now ask GET /v1/client/usage/root-detail with window=7d instead of window=1d, and Details labels the spend as reported over 7 days. Servers without the relay are unaffected.

downtime.detail: No startup work; the refresh cadence and read bounds are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; no persistent state changes.
